discoveries.reason: Retain: roughly qualifies the visible hemisphere; the statement concerns synchronized rotation, not an exactly fixed lunar appearance.
Retain: never describes a mathematical infinitude, not an empirical generalization from a sample.
Retain: first is limited to the observing missions described, not a claim about first existence of the pattern.
Retain: the instrument-assisted discovery category is explicit; NASA corroborates 1781 and the initially uncertain identification.
Retain: average distance and roughly bound the travel-time comparison.
Retain: first full orbit is explicitly bounded by the 1846 discovery and 2011 anniversary.
Retain as the institutionally described solar-system comparison; do not expand the category to all mountains or all astronomical objects.
Retain: only concerns the working quantity of finishing plaster, not a claim about every fresco technique.
Retain: pot-metal glass is the specified process; the contrast does not deny other glass decoration methods.
Retain: the text explicitly rejects universal damaged-code recovery and conditions it on correction level and damage.
Retain: the first-program claim specifies a digital electronic stored-program machine; it is not a first-computer claim.
Retain: generally qualifies the photosynthesis limit; the depth zone is identified by the question and title.
Retain: can and some qualify the mechanism and size comparison.
Retain: first research setting contrasts a documented origin with later use, not the first use of all nonstick materials.
Retain: the passage explicitly distinguishes crystal structure from damaged or combined falling flakes.
Retain: not always rejects the oversimplification rather than asserting a universal shape.
Retain: not the only is a contrast of feeding mechanisms, not a taxonomic superlative.
Retain: the passage rejects a universal finished-tooth assumption and scopes the example to enlarged canines.
Retain: the claim is limited to a UPC supermarket checkout scan and expressly excludes earlier barcode categories.
Retain: only one stage distinguishes life stages rather than denying exceptions across all insects.
Retain: only to a limited depth rejects inside-out heating as a universal mechanism.
Retain: can and the explicit non-solid-block qualification limit the freezing claim.
Retain: the date, approximate effect and idealized-model scope are explicit; the text rejects universal wing improvement.
Retain: not only broadens the described timing use without asserting exclusive dependence on GPS.
Retain: contribute and rather than relying only leave room for additional optical mechanisms.
Retain: the contrast concerns built-in stone arrangements, not all decoration at the site.
Retain: many and not every explicitly exclude a universal cheese-making claim.
Retain: this is a named cell specialization, not a statement about every human cell.
Retain: can and successive attempts describe possible accumulation, not an invariant nesting rule.
Retain: the text explicitly denies a guarantee against every breakage.
Retain: some and mainly keep the ripening location conditional.
Retain: not every snake expressly limits the taxonomic scope.
Retain: surviving volume, known and the named institution qualify the historical comparison.
Retain: only part distinguishes naming convention from the complete anatomical arrangement.
Retain: the text explicitly denies protection against every storm.
Retain: among the first is an erosion-order qualification, not a global first event.
Retain: the claim is bounded to a laser-cooled atomic fountain and the late 1980s, not the first atomic clock.
